items.html: And by this you will know the reason for what is known and explained, that all the phases of NHY of any of the Partzufim always come in the secret of an addition and are not essential, for that is why they are called ‘outside the body.’ And the reason is that in the Rosh of the Partzufim of Atzilut, which is Arich Anpin, in whom all the other Partzufim of Atzilut are clothed and held, as said above, his NHY have nothing to rely upon in Atik Yomin, since only the seven [lower Sefirot] of Atik are clothed in the seven first [Sefirot] of Arich Anpin, and in the NHY of Arich Anpin there is only an illumination alone, that comes out from the Yesod of Atik and expands in them. And therefore this matter continues in the NHY of all the other Partzufim.
